_comment: The client/ commit this demo sandbox was built against. tools/portal-sync.mjs compares it to the live development head and fails when the demo falls behind. Update it in the same commit that updates the sandbox — or, if client/ moved without changing anything a client can see, in the same commit as a note saying which commits were reviewed and why they do not affect the sandbox. Never re-pin without doing one of those two things.

reviewed.note: Three commits touched client/ since bae549922 and none changes a client-facing surface, so the sandbox was not rebuilt: 676076d is client/BACKLOG.md only; 5bca2cf adds DevRollbackInitialPanel, which RealSiteTab renders only behind site.devTools.enabled; d8ac01a is one line inside that same dev-only panel.
